第15章 只有我可以欺负你（第1页）
言安希问道：“回家？回慕家吗？”
她眼睛一转，赶紧回答：“当然是你去哪里，我就去哪里了。”
慕迟曜侧头看了她一眼，往后座上一靠：“言安希，以后记住自己的身份。慕太太，不是随随便便让人欺负的，明白吗？”
“你背后是我，谁跟你过不去，那就是跟我过去。”
言安希想了想，问：“那要是你跟我过不去呢？那你不就是在跟自己过不去吗？”
慕迟曜声音一低，沉沉的却带着磁性，宣示着主权：“谁都不可以欺负你，只有我可以。”
车子一路行驶着，最后在一座占地面积十分广阔，而且装修风格十分华丽的独栋复式别墅前停了下来。
言安希知道这里是哪里，慕城最贵的地段，最美的夜景，最高的大楼，都在这里。
而她眼前这栋别墅，堪比欧洲的城堡，处处彰显着精致贵气，喷泉，花园，草地，一应俱全。
雕花的大铁门缓缓打开，车子直接行驶进去，最后在喷泉旁边停了下来。
“原来你住这里，”言安希说，“难怪前几次去慕家，都没有遇到你……”
要是她见过慕迟曜，就不会稀里糊涂的睡了他，闹出这样的乌龙了。
慕迟曜说完，转身下了车，言安希也赶紧跟着下车。
她一直都跟在他身后，像一个小尾巴似的，可慕迟曜走进别墅里，穿过客厅，径直往二楼去了。
言安希还想跟着，却被一个四十多岁的中年男人拦了下来：“慕太太，您好，我是这里的管家。慕先生已经上楼，您不必跟着了。”
整栋别墅里安静得很，这么大的地方，又有这么多的佣人和保安，可是一点大的声响都没有，所有人走路都是静悄悄的，说话也是交头接耳，言安希走在二楼长长的走廊上，柔软的高级羊毛地毯，吞没了她的脚步声。
管家把她带到了一间卧室门口，十分客气的说：“太太，这就是您的房间，有什么需要，随时叫佣人。”
“太太，慕先生的房间在您对面。”
言安希连忙回头看了一眼，只看见对面的房门紧闭。
她撇了撇嘴，管家已经朝她鞠了一躬，走了。
言安希走进房间里，看着陌生的布置陌生的地方，一下子愣了。
其实她也无所谓住在哪里，她只有弟弟一个家人了，她……没有家了。
卧室很大，有洗手间有浴室有衣帽间，个人物品也都整整齐齐的摆放着。
言安希去衣帽间拿了一件浴袍，就去洗澡了。她舒服的躺在浴缸里，闭着眼睛，缓解这一天的疲劳。
她今天……太累了。而且，今天也发生了太多的事情。
直觉告诉她，慕迟曜不简单，他娶她……也不简单。

Chapter 15 Only I can bully you (Page 1)
Yan Anxi asked: "Go home? Go back to Mu's house?"
She rolled her eyes and quickly replied: "Of course, wherever you go, I will go."
Mu Chi Yao glanced sideways at her and leaned on the back seat: "Yan Anxi, remember your identity from now on. Mrs. Mu, you are not someone who can be easily bullied, do you understand?"
"I am behind you. Anyone who can't get along with you must come with me."
Yan Anxi thought for a while and asked, "What if you have trouble with me? Then aren't you just having trouble with yourself?"
Mu Chi Yao lowered his voice, deep but magnetic, declaring his sovereignty: "No one can bully you, only I can."
The car drove along and finally stopped in front of a single-family duplex villa that covered a very large area and was decorated in a very gorgeous style.
Yan Anxi knew where this place was. The most expensive area in Mucheng, the most beautiful night view, and the tallest building were all here.
The villa in front of her was comparable to a European castle, with exquisite elegance everywhere, including fountains, gardens, and lawns.
The large carved iron door slowly opened, and the car drove directly in, and finally stopped next to the fountain.
"So you live here," Yan Anxi said, "No wonder I didn't meet you the few times I went to Mu's house..."
If she had met Mu Chi Yao, she wouldn't have slept with him in a daze and made such a mistake.
After Mu Chi Yao finished speaking, he turned around and got out of the car, and Yan Anxi quickly followed suit.
She had been following him like a little tail, but Mu Chi Yao walked into the villa, passed through the living room, and went straight to the second floor.
Yan Anxi still wanted to follow, but was stopped by a middle-aged man in his forties: "Hello, Mrs. Mu, I am the housekeeper here. Mr. Mu has already gone upstairs, you don't have to follow."
The whole villa was very quiet. In such a big place, there were so many servants and security guards, but there was no loud noise. Everyone walked quietly and talked in whispers. Yan Anxi walked on the long corridor on the second floor, and the soft high-grade wool carpet swallowed up the sound of her footsteps.
The housekeeper took her to the door of a bedroom and said very politely: "Madam, this is your room. If you need anything, please call the servant at any time."
"Madam, Mr. Mu's room is opposite yours."
Yan Anxi quickly looked back and saw the door opposite was closed.
She curled her lips, but the housekeeper bowed to her and left.
Yan Anxi walked into the room and was stunned when she saw the unfamiliar layout and unfamiliar place.
In fact, she doesn't care where she lives. She only has her brother as a family member. She...has no home.
The bedroom is large, with a washroom, bathroom and cloakroom, and personal belongings are neatly placed.
Yan Anxi went to the cloakroom to get a bathrobe and took a shower. She lay comfortably in the bathtub with her eyes closed to relieve the fatigue of the day.
She was...too tired today. Moreover, too many things happened today.
Her intuition told her that Mu Chi Yao was not easy, and neither was him marrying her...
